findings.title: Claim form amount does not match bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital bill total and pharmacy bills.

findings.title: Billed ICU and room stay duration contradicts discharge summary
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 1 day of ICU and 3 days of room rent (total 4 days), but the patient was admitted for 4 days (07 Nov to 11 Nov).

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill date outside hospital stay
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated 07 Nov 2024, but the prescription reference on it is from a different context or the pharmacy is located in a different city than the hospital.

quotes.quote: Admission Date 07 Nov 2024 Discharge Date 11 Nov 2024
